name: demo_full_cycle
description: Full assurance lifecycle. The motor wears from tick 5 and settles at 15% wear (a stable worn state): Assured -> Flagged -> Nullified. At tick 60 the operator requests recalibration; the platform splits the flagged-period data by time, seals both parts, hands only the earlier part to the twin's owner, re-verifies and validates the recalibrated twin on the held-out later part, and issues a new assurance version. The compressor stays Flagged (its speed input remains below its assured range), so the system twin stays Flagged with that traced reason.
